ADBuddy classifies every adb command, journals every change so it can be undone,
and asks before anything irreversible.

Exit codes:
  0    success
  1    failure (see the error code)
  2    invalid usage
  75   temporary failure, retrying may help
  78   configuration error
  130  interrupted (Ctrl+C)

Usage:
  adbuddy [flags]
  adbuddy [command]

Available Commands:
  attach      Connect this terminal to the agent's session in adbuddy serve (Ctrl+] to detach)
  completion  Generate the autocompletion script for the specified shell
  connect     Connect to the phone by IP address and port (Tailscale or another network without mDNS)
  doctor      Check that ADBuddy, adb, the phone and the app are ready, and say how to fix what is not
  env         Manage the agent environment
  foreground  Show the app and activity in the phone's foreground
  help        Help about any command
  journal     Show the journal of adb commands and their inverses
  new         Start a new conversation in adbuddy serve, with another agent if given
  remote      Open adb's network port 5555 for 12 hours (remote mode), close it, or see its state
  run         Start a coding agent in the ADBuddy environment
  screen      List what is on the phone's screen: ids, texts and where to tap
  screenshot  Save a screenshot of the phone, scaled down
  send        Send a file of the environment to the user's phone (for the agent)
  serve       Run the ADBuddy host: live journal and confirmations for the agent's adb commands
  setup       Set up ADBuddy: get adb, pair the phone over Wi-Fi and prepare the agent environment
  stop        Stop the agent that adbuddy serve runs (serve keeps running)
  tap         Tap an element of the phone's screen by its text, its id or a point
  type        Type text in the focused field of the phone (it replaces what the field has)
  undo        Undo journaled changes by running their inverses
  version     Print the ADBuddy version

Flags:
  -h, --help      help for adbuddy
      --json      print machine-readable JSON on stdout
  -v, --version   version for adbuddy

Use "adbuddy [command] --help" for more information about a command.
